usage: 紅茶 is used as a noun to refer to black tea, a type of tea that is fully oxidized.
When ordering drinks, 紅茶 can be used to specify black tea instead of green or oolong tea.
In conversations about tea preferences, 紅茶 is commonly mentioned as a popular tea choice.
紅茶 can be combined with other words to describe variations, such as 'hot black tea' or 'iced black tea'.
